groupings.title: Independent review
groupings.description: Hand your work to a fresh, read-only reviewer running in a separate CLI process, and get back a structured verdict (approve / changes_required + findings).

groupings.title: Workstream runner
groupings.description: Drive one workstream end to end: validate it against the real code, review each plan/change with the review skills above, verify with the project's gates, reconcile docs and status with what actually shipped, and hand back a fixed staging contract.
